## Powerplay /Surge analysis 
```{r data_cleaning}
# Power surge rule first introduced date 
surge_intro_date <- as.Date("2020-12-10")

# Calculate match targets from first innings
match_targets <- df_ball_by_ball_data %>%
  group_by(match_id) %>%
  filter(innings == 1) %>%
  summarise(
    first_innings_total = sum(runs_total),
    target_to_win = first_innings_total + 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Aggregate ball-by-ball data to over-level 
df_over_analysis <- df_ball_by_ball_data %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  group_by(match_id, innings, over) %>%
  
  summarise(
    # get the static labels using first()
    date   = first(date),
    team1   = first(team1),
    team2   = first(team2),
    winner = first(winner),  # overall match winner
    bowler = first(bowler),
    
    #calculations needed
    over_total_runs  = sum(runs_total),
    over_batter_runs = sum(runs_batter),
    over_extras      = sum(runs_total - runs_batter),
    over_wickets     = sum(wicket),
    boundaries       = sum(runs_batter %in% c(4, 6)),
    dot_balls        = sum(runs_total == 0),
    pp_type          = first(powerplay_type),
    venue  = first(venue),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    era = ifelse(date < surge_intro_date, "Pre_Surge", "Surge_Era"),
    pp_type = replace_na(pp_type, "none")
  )

# Define match phases using era-specific rules (6-over vs 4+2 system)
df_over_analysis <- df_over_analysis %>%
  mutate(match_phase = case_when(
    era == "Pre_Surge" & over <= 6 ~ "Mandatory_PP",
    era == "Surge_Era" & over <= 4 ~ "Mandatory_PP",
    pp_type == "batting" ~ "Power_Surge",
    over >= 16 ~ "Death",
    TRUE ~ "Middle"
  ))

# cumulative match state and current run rate
df_over_analysis <- df_over_analysis %>%
  arrange(match_id, innings, over) %>%
  group_by(match_id, innings) %>%
  mutate(
    current_score = cumsum(over_total_runs),
    wickets_lost = cumsum(over_wickets),
    current_run_rate = current_score / over
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Join targets and calculate Required Run Rate (RRR) for second innings
df_over_analysis <- df_over_analysis %>%
  left_join(match_targets, by = "match_id") %>%
  mutate(
    runs_remaining = ifelse(innings == 2, target_to_win - current_score, NA),
    overs_remaining = 20 - over,
    req_run_rate = case_when(
      innings == 1 ~ NA_real_,
      runs_remaining <= 0 ~ 0,
      overs_remaining == 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ runs_remaining / overs_remaining
    )
  )
```

## Merging datsets (player Metadata & Bowling styles)
```{r merging_datasets}
colnames(player_meta_data)
colnames(my_bowlers)

bowler_type_map <- my_bowlers %>%
  # Clean join using the matching column name
  left_join(player_meta_data, by = "key_cricinfo") %>%
  select(key_cricinfo, unique_name, bowling_style) %>%
  mutate(bowling_category = case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(bowling_style), "fast|medium|seam|swing") ~ "Pace",
    str_detect(tolower(bowling_style), "spin|break|orthodox|leg|wrist") ~ "Spin",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  ))
```



### creating over level dataset using bally by ball 
```{r creating_master_dataset}
# Combining Datasets Part 2 
# creating master dataset by merging datset from ResearchProject A to be used In part B 

# datasset(df_part_1 was used in research project Part A)
df_master <- df_part_2 %>%
  left_join(
    df_part_1 %>%
      select(
        match_id,
        season,
        toss_winner,
        toss_decision,
        home_team,
        home_wins,
        toss_win_game_win,
        toss_winner_home
      ),
    by = "match_id"
  )

colnames(df_master)
```

#EDA V1
```{r EDA_v1}
unique(df_master$match_phase)
unique(df_master$pp_type)
# Runs by match phase
df_master %>%
  group_by(match_phase) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_runs = mean(over_total_runs, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_wickets = mean(over_wickets, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_boundaries = mean(boundaries, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

df_master %>%
  group_by(match_phase, bowling_category) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_runs = mean(over_total_runs, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_wickets = mean(over_wickets, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Since the Power Surge rule was introduced on 10 December 2020, the exploratory analysis compares matches played before and after this date. Before the rule change innings were divided into three phases: Mandatory Powerplay, Middle, and Death. After the introduction of the Power Surge, a fourth phase, Power Surge, was added. Therefore, the analysis examines whether scoring patterns, wicket loss, boundary frequency, and bowling effectiveness changed across phases between the two periods.

# Power Surge introduction date
surge_intro_date <- as.Date("2020-12-10")

df_eda <- df_master %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    surge_period = case_when(
      date < surge_intro_date ~ "Before Power Surge",
      TRUE ~ "After Power Surge"
    )
  )

# Summary of scoring by phase and period
bowling_phase_period_summary <- df_eda %>%
  group_by(surge_period, match_phase, bowling_category) %>%
  summarise(
    overs = n(),
    avg_runs = mean(over_total_runs, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_wickets = mean(over_wickets, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Visualise bowling type effect on runs
ggplot(bowling_phase_period_summary,
       aes(x = match_phase, y = avg_runs, fill = bowling_category)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ surge_period) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Runs per Over by Bowling Type and Match Phase",
    x = "Match Phase",
    y = "Average Runs per Over",
    fill = "Bowling Type"
  )

# Visualise bowling type effect on wickets
ggplot(bowling_phase_period_summary,
       aes(x = match_phase, y = avg_wickets, fill = bowling_category)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ surge_period) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Wickets per Over by Bowling Type and Match Phase",
    x = "Match Phase",
    y = "Average Wickets per Over",
    fill = "Bowling Type"
  )
```
```{r}
over_profile <- df_master %>%

    title = "Average Runs per Over by Innings",
    x = "Over",

    color = "Innings"
  )


# Before vs after Power Surge by over
surge_over_profile <- df_master %>%
  mutate(
    surge_period = if_else(
      as.Date(date) < as.Date("2020-12-10"),
      "Before Power Surge",
      "After Power Surge"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(surge_period, over) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_runs = mean(over_total_runs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ggplot(surge_over_profile, aes(x = over, y = avg_runs, color = surge_period)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Runs per Over Before and After Power Surge Introduction",
    x = "Over",
    y = "Average Runs",
    color = "Period"
  )
```
